Sentences about abstract, institutional, business, legal-procedural, software, opinion or feelings built from common single-token words ('The new policy will affect all employees.', 'Click the button to download the file.', 'He believes that honesty is important.') stay below 0.25 x max, and so do near-synonyms that drop the trigger form ('plentiful', 'high-quality', 'knockout mice', 'Neurology').
